blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two Filipinos reached academic highs in Canada, graduating as valedictorians at the Southern Alberta Institute of Technology (SAIT). One of them was Troy Fonz Secondez, who earned his diploma in Business Administration, majoring in Supply Chain Management. READ: Canada is one of the top choices for Filipinos to study abroad According to Secondez, he carried his family’s hopes and Filipino pride in his journey becoming one of SAIT’s three Fall 2026 valedictorians. “For every Filipino living far from home, missing familiar faces, food, and the comfort of being with family, I hope this reminds you that even from […]...
